task: Fix the Models table on Project details so all rows have uniform height and provider text no longer overlaps capability tags.

key_reasoning.reason: Acceptance criteria (uniform row height, no provider/capability overlap) are clear, but technical-analysis flags an open design decision: the existing uncommitted h-12 + flex-wrap patch is only a floor and doesn't guarantee single-line content, so the right combination of truncate/flex-nowrap/column-width needs to be settled before implementation.

Pure Tailwind/CSS layout fix on an existing table component — well-established styling pattern, no security or performance implications, trivial rollback. Scored S rather than XS because the correct fix must be verified across two call sites (inline section vs. popup) and because the tech-analysis highlights that the naive h-12 approach can still regress under flex-wrap.
